subject: verify-case.py red/check run 'regression --case' through testiface with AC_CODE_ROOT per copy; red classification from result.json fields, unmeasured on missing fields
objective: Design docs/design/project-runnable-entries.md (D-071) C7, section 4 'verify-case red / check' row, section 8 V11, follow-up row 3c. (1) scripts/verify-case.py red and check no longer spawn 'python3 -m unittest -v' in the copies. For each copy they already run today (red: the clean base copy only - red never runs the candidate, D-020, candidate_run stays None; check: the clean base copy and the candidate copy via branch/sha/worktree path) they call scripts/testiface.py regression --case <file>... with AC_CODE_ROOT=<that copy>, AC_TEST_MODE verify-red (red) / verify-check (check), AC_TICKET/AC_RUN_ID as today, a distinct AC_TEST_OUT per copy under the out dir, AC_TEST_TIMEOUT = board/config.json verify_case.timeout_seconds (#156, key unchanged; passed through, testiface enforces it). The project's tests.regression command or the built-in verify.py --case --result runs the cases. (2) Classification reads result.json rows (D-020 table unchanged, only the source changes): a row with status fail/error whose exception is AssertionError (or a subclass name ending in AssertionError) and whose file is one of the ticket's verify.files -> red (red_lines from id + message); exception in ImportError/ModuleNotFoundError or an error row whose message starts with 'Failed to import' -> import_failures; AttributeError/NameError naming a missing symbol -> missing_symbol; any other fail/error whose file is not in verify.files -> elsewhere (does not count); skip rows counted as skipped; cases = number of ids. rc/cases/skipped/log keys of the returned dict keep their names (callers and the ticket's verify.baseline shape unchanged). (3) Unmeasured (no ticket write, rc 2, today's unmeasured() text): any fail/error row with exception null; result.json missing or schema != 1 (testiface already returns 2 for those); timeout (today's CaseTimeout message naming verify_case.timeout_seconds and the partial log). (4) Delete the log-text classification path: parse_reds / traceback_end / red_shape / frame_in-on-tracebacks go (or are reduced to pure helpers over result rows); the '-m unittest' spawn is gone. The log files (regression.log per copy) stay in the out dir as evidence; 'leaves only logs behind' holds.
acceptance: A1 V11 counts (tests/test_verify_case.py, fixture project from row 3b as the sandbox, verify.files = the fixture's one case file): clean base copy where the case fails with an assertEqual in the case file -> 'verify-case.py red' rc 0 (red measures the base copy only), output lists the case under red, red_lines contains the row's message text, ticket verify.baseline written as today; then 'check' with a candidate where the case is green records the candidate side green; existing cases test_red_on_clean_main_and_green_on_candidate_is_recorded and test_an_assertion_in_the_case_file_counts_and_lands_in_red_lines stay green (oracle: tests/test_verify_case.py 183, 491).

A2 shapes that do not count (tests/test_verify_case.py): candidate whose case file imports a missing module -> listed under import failures, not red (existing test at 206 green); candidate whose case references a missing symbol -> missing_symbol (existing 516); candidate where the assertion is in the case but the failing frame is product code (raise inside src/) -> elsewhere and 'does not count' (existing 527); a skip row -> skipped count 1, not red. All four assert the classification text the tool prints today (oracle: those cases' expected strings).

A3 unmeasured (tests/test_verify_case.py, fixture regression command knobs via AC_TEST_FAKE_REGRESSION in {null-exception, no-result, sleep} - knobs added to the fixture's scripts/ac-tests.sh in this ticket): null-exception (fail row, exception null) -> rc 2, output contains 'unmeasured' and the row id, tickets/<n>.json byte-identical; no-result -> rc 2, byte-identical; sleep with verify_case.timeout_seconds 1 -> rc 2 within 30 s, output names 'verify_case.timeout_seconds' and the partial log path, byte-identical. Mutation (not measured by opener): null exception treated as red -> first arm red.

A4 roots and out dir (tests/test_verify_case.py): the fixture's regression command appends AC_CODE_ROOT, AC_TEST_MODE and AC_TEST_OUT per invocation to $AC_TEST_CALLS; after 'red' there is exactly one invocation, AC_CODE_ROOT = the clean base copy under the out dir, AC_TEST_MODE 'verify-red' (red never runs the candidate: D-020, existing assertion candidate_run is None at tests/test_verify_case.py 501 stays); after 'check' (candidate given as a branch) there are exactly two invocations, AC_CODE_ROOT values are the base copy and the candidate copy (both under the out dir, distinct), AC_TEST_MODE 'verify-check' both, AC_TEST_OUT distinct; existing test_check_leaves_only_logs_behind_in_the_out_dir and test_red_leaves_only_logs_behind_in_the_out_dir green (301, 361), i.e. result.json dirs are removed or counted as logs - say which in EVIDENCE and keep the assertion unchanged.

A5 static + module: grep -c '"-m", "unittest"' scripts/verify-case.py == 0; grep -c 'def parse_reds\|def traceback_end' scripts/verify-case.py == 0; tests/test_verify_case.py is green as a module (61 cases at base; cases that unit-tested the log-text parser on hand-written tracebacks are rewritten to feed result rows with the same expected classification, listed by name in EVIDENCE); tests/test_gate.py verify_case layer cases (D-020 C5 ordering) green.
